done_when: The 'Releasing Forge' section of docs/guide.md says: cut once a day at 05:00 UTC from the newest main commit whose Linux full run and Windows run passed; the contents are frozen at the cut and only a fix without which the release is unsafe or its checks cannot pass may join; later work waits for the next day; publish within 30 minutes of the cut without a separate owner yes; skip the day when nothing merged or main is red

known.title: Functional: A frozen cut cannot be pushed after main advances
Functional: The checklist can tag a different commit from the tested cut
Gate: Reconcile the coordinator's release instructions

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - another fix merges after the nightly runs but before 05:00, with main's normal checks green.
The new rule selects the latest commit with both passed runs, but `src/forge/fullrun.py:34` checks the current main commit and `src/forge/githooks.py:162` refuses a release tag unless it points to that commit. A tag on the earlier, fully tested cut therefore cannot be pushed, even if the newer commit later gets a green full run. The tree comparison at `docs/guide.md:704` also requires the tag to match moving main. The coordinator's docs-only ruling did not account for this existing gate, so the release must wait or include later work.
findings.title: Functional: A frozen cut cannot be pushed after main advances

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a maintainer selects the 05:00 cut, then follows the numbered release steps.
Step 1 at `docs/guide.md:695` merges a version bump after that selection. This step reuses the cut commit's runs, while step 3 at `docs/guide.md:702` tags the version-bump merge, so the tagged tree is not the one whose runs passed. The pre-push gate at `src/forge/githooks.py:162` then refuses the tag until the new commit has a green full run. The checklist needs to place the version bump before the tested cut and identify the cut as the commit to tag.
findings.title: Functional: The checklist can tag a different commit from the tested cut

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - a coordinator releases Forge when the selected commit already has two green nightly runs.
This step says to reuse those runs, but `src/forge/templates/skill.md:2306` tells the coordinator to start and watch a fresh full run after the last product merge. The repository's review rule requires a skill or brief update when a coordinator step changes; neither was updated. The coordinator's docs-only ruling did not address the conflicting shipped instruction, which can add a full-run wait to the release.
Adds work: reconcile the agent's release guidance; F 3 x H 2 = 6; 2 x C = 2
findings.title: Gate: Reconcile the coordinator's release instructions

why: Forge releases wait on scope added during the release: v1.2.44 waited about 20 hours while four fixes were added after the cut; the owner chose on 20 Nov 2026 one release a day from green main, with frozen contents, published without a separate owner yes
